texts.preamble: Mahesh vs The State Of M.P. on 23 August, 2024 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Crr No. 4242 of 2024 (Mahesh Vs The State Of M.P. And Others Dated : 23-08-2024
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant 2 CRR-4242-2024 submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this matter. During the trial and during the appeal applicant remained on bail and he has not misused the [LEAKAGE_MASK] to him. Learned counsel for the applicant has supplied the certified copy of order dated 22.08.2024 in RCT No. 2617417/2008 which reveals that applicant has surrendered before the Court below and now he is in custody. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.
